properties.name: smd.opentelemetry.enabled
properties.description: Whether to record the buses' invocations as OpenTelemetry spans when an OpenTelemetry bean exists.

properties.name: smd.event-store.enabled
properties.description: Whether event store support is enabled.

properties.name: smd.event-store.scheduling.enabled
properties.description: Whether event store polling is enabled.

properties.name: smd.event-store.scheduling.initial-delay
properties.description: Delay before the first poll after startup.

properties.name: smd.event-store.scheduling.polling-delay
properties.description: Fixed delay between successive polls.

properties.name: smd.event-store.scheduling.thread-pool-size
properties.description: Number of threads in the polling scheduler thread pool.

properties.name: smd.event-store.processing.max-retries
properties.description: Maximum number of retries before a failed event is abandoned.

properties.name: smd.event-store.processing.batch-size
properties.description: Maximum number of events fetched and scanned per poll cycle.

properties.name: smd.event-store.processing.gap-timeout
properties.description: How long to wait for a gap in sequence numbers to fill before skipping.

properties.name: smd.event-store.processing.retry-backoff.strategy
properties.description: Backoff strategy for failed event retries.

properties.name: smd.event-store.processing.retry-backoff.fixed-delay
properties.description: Delay between retries when using the FIXED strategy.

properties.name: smd.event-store.processing.retry-backoff.base-delay
properties.description: Base delay for LINEAR and EXPONENTIAL strategies.

properties.name: smd.event-store.processing.retry-backoff.multiplier
properties.description: Multiplier applied per retry for the EXPONENTIAL strategy.

properties.name: smd.event-store.processing.retry-backoff.increment
properties.description: Delay increment per retry for the LINEAR strategy.

properties.name: smd.event-store.processing.retry-backoff.max-delay
properties.description: Upper bound on retry delay for LINEAR and EXPONENTIAL strategies.

properties.name: smd.durable-delivery.enabled
properties.description: Whether to create a DurableDelivery bean, which creates durable event dispatchers. Requires a ConnectionProvider or DataSource.

properties.name: smd.durable-delivery.scheduling.thread-pool-size
properties.description: Number of threads that deliver to the subscribers of durable event dispatchers. Defaults to the number of available processors.

properties.name: smd.durable-delivery.scheduling.idle-backoff.strategy
properties.description: Backoff strategy for the delay between polls that find no work, counted from the last poll that found work.

properties.name: smd.durable-delivery.scheduling.idle-backoff.fixed-delay
properties.description: Delay between idle polls when using the FIXED strategy.

properties.name: smd.durable-delivery.scheduling.idle-backoff.base-delay
properties.description: Delay after the first idle poll for LINEAR and EXPONENTIAL strategies.

properties.name: smd.durable-delivery.scheduling.idle-backoff.multiplier
properties.description: Multiplier applied per idle poll for the EXPONENTIAL strategy.

properties.name: smd.durable-delivery.scheduling.idle-backoff.increment
properties.description: Delay increment per idle poll for the LINEAR strategy.

properties.name: smd.durable-delivery.scheduling.idle-backoff.max-delay
properties.description: Upper bound on the idle delay for LINEAR and EXPONENTIAL strategies.

properties.name: smd.durable-delivery.processing.batch-size
properties.description: Maximum number of events one poll delivers to a subscriber, in one transaction.

properties.name: smd.durable-delivery.processing.lane-count
properties.description: Number of lanes per subscriber. Events of a subject share a lane; a lane delivers in order, one worker at a time. Must match the count the dispatcher was registered with.

properties.name: smd.durable-delivery.processing.retry-backoff.strategy
properties.description: Backoff strategy for retrying an event a subscriber failed to handle.

properties.name: smd.durable-delivery.processing.retry-backoff.fixed-delay
properties.description: Delay between retries when using the FIXED strategy.

properties.name: smd.durable-delivery.processing.retry-backoff.base-delay
properties.description: Base delay for LINEAR and EXPONENTIAL strategies.

properties.name: smd.durable-delivery.processing.retry-backoff.multiplier
properties.description: Multiplier applied per retry for the EXPONENTIAL strategy.

properties.name: smd.durable-delivery.processing.retry-backoff.increment
properties.description: Delay increment per retry for the LINEAR strategy.

properties.name: smd.durable-delivery.processing.retry-backoff.max-delay
properties.description: Upper bound on retry delay for LINEAR and EXPONENTIAL strategies.
